(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const S=__rhf.session; const C={x:-6,z:-154}; const all=()=>[...new Set([...g.colliders.grid.values()].flat())]; window.__trees=()=>all().filter(c=>c.tag==='tree'&&Math.hypot(c.x-C.x,c.z-C.z)<24).length; window.__logs=()=>g.colliders.boxes.filter(b=>b.tag==='log').length; window.__pods=()=>all().filter(c=>c.tag==='pod').length; const m=g.wtex.mask.image.data; window.__grass=()=>{let s=0; for(let j=0;j<4096;j++){} const N=Math.round(Math.sqrt(m.length/4)); const CS=3.125, HALF=N*CS/2; for(let j=Math.floor((C.z-12+HALF)/CS); j<=Math.ceil((C.z+12+HALF)/CS); j++) for(let i=Math.floor((C.x-12+HALF)/CS); i<=Math.ceil((C.x+12+HALF)/CS); i++) s+=m[(i+j*N)*4]; return s}; window.__t0=window.__trees(); window.__g0=window.__grass(); g.state.visitor={stage:'friend',follow:true,at:{day:1,time:1}}; g.visitor.restore(); const Z=g.visitor.zib; for(let i=0;i<400&&Z.sculpt;i++) Z.sculptStep(50); for(let i=0;i<10;i++) S.update(0.05); return 'A1 site built: trees near '+window.__t0+' -> '+window.__trees()+', logs '+window.__logs()+', pod '+window.__pods()+', grass '+window.__g0+' -> '+window.__grass()+'; zib '+Z.pos.distanceTo(g.player.pos).toFixed(1)+' m from you; clearing discovered '+!!g.state.discovered.crash+', parking '+!!g.props.layout.parking.crash})()
